Usage: g pick (--north | --south) (--north | --east) (--east | --west) [flags]

Pick a direction.

Flags:
      --north    Go north.
      --south    Go south.
      --east     Go east.
      --west     Go west.
      --quiet    Say less.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help     Show context-sensitive help.

Constraints:
  Exactly one of --north, --south.
  Exactly one of --north, --east.
  Exactly one of --east, --west.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
